per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to routine interactions (browsing, searching, loading details) within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete the checkout flow within 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure streaming startup and buffering times are within single-digit seconds, with a maximum tolerable time of 10 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall maintain an uptime availability of 99.5%.
The system shall encrypt payment data at rest and restrict access to a very small set of administrators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement role-based access control (RBAC) with least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and audit trails for admin actions.
The system shall display a clear privacy notice upfront and include a persistent footer link for user reference.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement rate-limiting, anomaly alerts, and automated flags for suspicious activity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prefer tokenization for payment data and, if storing cards, ensure strict encryption and access controls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall have a UI design that is forgiving for novice users, with big buttons, simple language, and an African-inspired aesthetic.
The system shall implement a mix of automated filters and human review for moderating user-generated content.
The system shall implement centralized logging with retention for months (operational) to years (compliance).
The system shall implement observability with dashboards, alerts, and SRE ownership for monitoring.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement role-specific admin UIs with simple workflows for catalog management, pre-paid card generation, and other admin tasks.
The system shall implement synthetic transactions and page-load tests to validate performance post-launch.
